<action type="say">
I can look this up if your ticket was booked through this service.

Do you have any of the following for this trip:
- Booking confirmation code, or
- The email address and last name used on the booking (and ideally your phone number on the booking too)?

- Once you have the flight number, tell me (e.g., “It’s AA1234 from PHL to ORD today”), and I can check the status directly.</action>
